category: MediaPipe / Google AI Edge / Object Detector / Web ML
headline: Object Detector はモデル資産と delegate route を先に点検する
headlineEn: Object Detector benefits from asset and delegate preflight before camera hookup
summary: Google AI Edge の Object Detector Web guide、Web setup、ObjectDetector JavaScript API、MediaPipe releases、mediapipe-samples-web の Object Detector worker を確認し、自作サンプルを2本追加しました。本命は WASM path、modelAssetPath、CPU/GPU delegate、scoreThreshold、maxResults の初期化リスクを見る Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight、派生は WASM / model / delegate の温め方を比較する Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline です。
summaryEn: After checking the Google AI Edge Object Detector Web guide, Web setup guide, ObjectDetector JavaScript API, MediaPipe releases, and the Object Detector worker in mediapipe-samples-web, this adds two original samples. The main sample is Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight, which explores WASM path, modelAssetPath, CPU/GPU delegate, scoreThreshold, and maxResults initialization risk. The derivative is Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline, which compares warmup strategies for WASM, model, and delegate state.
keyTopics: Object Detector Web guide は `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`、`FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()`、`ObjectDetector.createFromOptions()`、`modelAssetPath`、`scoreThreshold`、`runningMode` を使う構成を示している。
Web setup guide は MediaPipe Tasks の vision/text/audio ライブラリ、CDN / npm 導入、BaseOptions の `modelAssetPath` と CPU/GPU delegate を整理している。
ObjectDetector JavaScript API は `createFromModelPath()` や `createFromOptions()` など、WASM runtime とモデル資産の初期化点を分けている。
`mediapipe-samples-web` の Object Detector worker は公式サンプル実装の参照に使えるが、今日の公開カードは外部デモ一覧ではなく、自作の preflight UI にした。
Web ML の実運用では、検出精度だけでなく、WASM / model fetch、delegate startup、キャッシュ、fallback、初回操作の体感遅延を先に計測できる形が重要になる。
keyTopicsEn: The Object Detector Web guide shows a setup using `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`, `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()`, `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions()`, `modelAssetPath`, `scoreThreshold`, and `runningMode`.
The Web setup guide covers MediaPipe Tasks vision/text/audio libraries, CDN / npm setup, BaseOptions `modelAssetPath`, and CPU/GPU delegate configuration.
The ObjectDetector JavaScript API separates initialization points for the Wasm runtime and model assets through methods such as `createFromModelPath()` and `createFromOptions()`.
The Object Detector worker in `mediapipe-samples-web` is useful as an official implementation reference, while today's public cards are original preflight UIs rather than an external demo list.

In production Web ML, detection quality is only part of the problem; it is also important to measure WASM/model fetch, delegate startup, cache behavior, fallback, and first-interaction latency before launch.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は Object Detector の検出結果そのものではなく、検出を始める前の asset / delegate preflight です。公式 Web guide は `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()` と `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions()` で WASM とモデルを準備し、`modelAssetPath`、`scoreThreshold`、`runningMode` を渡す流れを示しています。Web setup guide では BaseOptions の `modelAssetPath` と CPU/GPU delegate が整理されているため、初回起動の体感遅延、モデル URL の失敗、GPU fallback を UI として点検しやすい形にしました。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable angle is not the Object Detector result itself, but the asset / delegate preflight before detection starts. The official Web guide prepares WASM and the model with `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()` and `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions()`, passing `modelAssetPath`, `scoreThreshold`, and `runningMode`. The Web setup guide documents BaseOptions `modelAssetPath` and CPU/GPU delegate configuration, so this turns first-start latency, model URL failures, and GPU fallback into an inspectable UI.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命サンプル `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight` は model weight、scene density、score threshold、max results、delegate、network jitter、asset path failure を操作し、合成 object box と init / inference time、fallback、emit / hold 数を表示します。派生の `Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline` は eager warmup、lazy first use、stale while revalidate 風の cache policy を比較し、WASM / model / map buffer / delegate warm / first detect の時間をタイムラインで表示します。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight`, adjusts model weight, scene density, score threshold, max results, delegate, network jitter, and asset path failure while showing synthetic object boxes, init / inference time, fallback, and emit / hold counts. The derivative, `Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline`, compares eager warmup, lazy first use, and stale-while-revalidate-style cache policies while displaying WASM / model / map buffer / delegate warm / first detect timings.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.titleEn: Possibilities unlocked by sample data and combinations
sections.body: 蓄積できるデータは WASM path の取得時間、modelAssetPath の取得時間、model size、delegate startup、CPU/GPU fallback、score threshold、max results、object count、selected count、held count、初回 detectForVideo 予算、cache hit / miss、offline usable です。Object Detector、Image Classifier、Image Embedder、Face Detector、Web Worker、Service Worker Cache Storage、IndexedDB、PerformanceObserver、Resource Timing、WebRTC camera metadata と組み合わせると、実モデル接続後も同じ UI で運用劣化を追えます。
sections.bodyEn: The samples can accumulate WASM path fetch time, modelAssetPath fetch time, model size, delegate startup, CPU/GPU fallback, score threshold, max results, object count, selected count, held count, first detectForVideo budget, cache hit / miss, and offline usability. Combined with Object Detector, Image Classifier, Image Embedder, Face Detector, Web Workers, Service Worker Cache Storage, IndexedDB, PerformanceObserver, Resource Timing, and WebRTC camera metadata, the same UI can track operational degradation after real model hookup.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 実接続時は Web setup guide に合わせて `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` の version と WASM path を固定し、`FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(basePath)`、`ObjectDetector.createFromOptions(vision, { baseOptions: { modelAssetPath, delegate }, scoreThreshold, runningMode })`、`detect()` / `detectForVideo()` を分けて計測します。モデル URL は 404 / CORS / cache miss を区別し、GPU first の場合は初期化失敗時に CPU route を明示的にログへ残すと、ユーザー環境差の調査が楽になります。
sections.bodyEn: When connecting a real model, pin the `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` version and WASM path according to the Web setup guide, then measure `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(basePath)`, `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions(vision, { baseOptions: { modelAssetPath, delegate }, scoreThreshold, runningMode })`, and `detect()` / `detectForVideo()` separately. For model URLs, distinguish 404, CORS, and cache misses; when using GPU-first, log explicit CPU fallback after startup failure so device-specific issues are easier to debug.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 明日以降は `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` の rc / nightly、MediaPipe release notes の JavaScript bundle / WASM / delegate 関連、Object Detector Web guide の modelAssetPath 例、`mediapipe-samples-web` の worker message shape、Google AI Edge Gallery 側の Web task 実装差分を見ます。
sections.bodyEn: Next, watch `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` rc / nightly versions, JavaScript bundle / WASM / delegate notes in MediaPipe release notes, Object Detector Web guide modelAssetPath examples, worker message shapes in `mediapipe-samples-web`, and implementation changes in Google AI Edge Gallery Web tasks.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight` で Model weight を大きくして Delegate を GPU first にし、Inject network jitter と Break asset path を押すと、asset route と fallback の壊れ方が見えます。派生では Cache policy を lazy first use に変え、Evict cache と Toggle offline を押すと、初回操作へ遅延を押し付ける設計のリスクが見えます。
sections.bodyEn: In `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight`, increase Model weight, set Delegate to GPU first, then press Inject network jitter and Break asset path to see asset-route and fallback failure modes. In the derivative, switch Cache policy to lazy first use, then press Evict cache and Toggle offline to see the risk of pushing latency onto the first user action.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Object Detector Web guide、Web setup、ObjectDetector JavaScript API、MediaPipe releases、mediapipe-samples-web、Object Detector worker source、npm package を確認。設計: 公式 demo の一覧化ではなく、asset / delegate preflight と cache warmup を触る自作 UI にする。実装: 本命 HTML に model weight、density、threshold、max results、delegate、jitter、asset failure、合成 object boxes を追加。派生 HTML に eager / lazy / stale cache policy、offline、evict、WASM / model / delegate timeline を追加。検証: JSON parse、gallery build、publish command、GitHub Pages の top / day / representative sample HTTP 200 を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked the Object Detector Web guide, Web setup guide, ObjectDetector JavaScript API, MediaPipe releases, mediapipe-samples-web, Object Detector worker source, and npm package. Design: instead of listing official demos, create original UIs for asset / delegate preflight and cache warmup. Implementation: added model weight, density, threshold, max results, delegate, jitter, asset failure, and synthetic object boxes to the main HTML. Added eager / lazy / stale cache policy, offline, evict, and WASM / model / delegate timeline to the derivative HTML. Validation: check JSON parsing, gallery build, publish command, and GitHub Pages HTTP 200 for the top page, day page, and representative sample.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 昨日は Gesture Recognizer の runningMode と timestamp hygiene を扱いました。今日は Object Detector に移り、フレーム制御のさらに手前にある asset loading、model path、delegate choice、cache warmup を部品化しました。これで日次サンプルは認識結果、イベント化、フレーム運用に加えて、Web ML アプリの起動前チェックまで一段広がっています。
sections.bodyEn: Yesterday handled Gesture Recognizer runningMode and timestamp hygiene. Today moves to Object Detector and componentizes the layer even before frame control: asset loading, model path, delegate choice, and cache warmup. The daily samples now cover not only recognition results, event routing, and frame operations, but also startup preflight for Web ML apps.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した本命は `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight` です。実際に動く部分は WASM / modelAssetPath 取得時間の合成、delegate fallback、scoreThreshold / maxResults、合成 object boxes、emit / hold counters、asset path failure です。次に足すなら実 `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions` adapter、Resource Timing 計測、worker transfer 計測、model metadata 表示を足します。派生試作は `Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline` で、実際に動く部分は eager / lazy / stale cache policy、offline toggle、cache evict、WASM / model / delegate warmup timeline です。次に足すなら Service Worker Cache Storage、IndexedDB timing log、real fetch HEAD check、offline-first manifest を足します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `Object Detector Asset Delegate Preflight`. The working pieces are synthetic WASM / modelAssetPath fetch timing, delegate fallback, scoreThreshold / maxResults, synthetic object boxes, emit / hold counters, and asset path failure. Next additions should include a real `ObjectDetector.createFromOptions` adapter, Resource Timing measurements, worker transfer measurements, and model metadata display. The derivative prototype is `Model Asset Cache Warmup Timeline`; the working pieces are eager / lazy / stale cache policy, offline toggle, cache evict, and WASM / model / delegate warmup timeline. Next additions should include Service Worker Cache Storage, IndexedDB timing logs, real fetch HEAD checks, and an offline-first manifest.
